name: PVR INOX Ltd
tagline: India's largest multiplex chain, still working through post-merger integration - stock at multi-year lows, low single-digit ROE, and a still-uncertain content/footfall recovery.
business_overview: PVR INOX (NSE/BSE: PVRINOX) is India's largest cinema exhibition chain, formed from the 2023 merger of PVR and INOX Leisure. It operates multiplex screens pan-India, monetising through box-office admissions, F&B, and advertising/branding revenue, with an increasingly asset-heavy lease footprint typical of the exhibition business.

fundamentals_narrative: PVR INOX is still digesting the 2023 merger: box-office recovery has been uneven post-pandemic, content pipeline quality has been inconsistent, and occupancy/footfall have not returned to pre-COVID trend in a durable way, which shows up in a weak ~4.5% ROE. Forward revenue growth (~10.3%/yr) is unremarkable relative to the broader market. Screen additions and cost synergies from the merger remain the operative bull case, but nothing found this pass confirms those synergies are flowing through to returns yet.
technical_read: Stock has been in a sustained downtrend, previously hitting 44-month lows (~23% off its December high per news flow); currently trading well below its 52-week high (~Rs 1,250) near the ~Rs 907-966 area.
